Protecting San Francisco Roofs

Why Local Property Owners Trust Roof Express

From the dense foggy mornings in the Sunset District to the heavy atmospheric river storms rolling across the Bay, San Francisco properties demand a roofing system that can withstand intense coastal humidity and heavy rainfall.

At Roof Express, we specialize in providing San Francisco homeowners, property managers, and commercial building owners with dependable, fast-response roofing and general contracting services designed specifically for SF's unique architecture.

Tailored Roofing Solutions for SF Architecture

Navigating San Francisco building codes, historic preservation requirements, and compact property lines requires local expertise. Whether you own a Victorian in Pacific Heights, a Marina flat, or a commercial building Downtown, our team delivers custom solutions:

 Victorian & Edwardian Restorations: Specialized care for complex roof pitch angles, ornamental detailing, and exterior scaffolding.

 Flat & Low-Slope Roof Systems: Expert application of TPO, single-ply, and torch-down roofing tailored for classic SF multi-family units and commercial spaces.

 Atmospheric River & Storm Protection: Complete waterproofing, continuous gutter installations, and emergency leak patching built to resist SF winter storms.

 Scaffolding & Exterior Maintenance: Safe, fully permitted scaffolding setup for multi-story townhomes and tight neighborhood lots.

The Roof Express SF Advantage

 Diamond Certified® Quality: Recognized across the Bay Area for top-tier customer satisfaction and verified craftsmanship.

 San Francisco Local HQ: Based right at 58 West Portal Ave, allowing us to respond quickly to emergency leak calls throughout the city.

 Transparent Inspection Reports: High-resolution digital photo reports so you can clearly view your roof's condition without ever leaving the ground.

 Fully Licensed & Insured: CSLB Lic #1072766, operating with full compliance to San Francisco Department of Building Inspection (DBI) standards.

San Francisco Neighborhood Service Areas

We provide rapid dispatch and comprehensive service across all San Francisco neighborhoods, including:

 Sunset & Richmond Districts

 Pacific Heights & Marina

 Mission & Noe Valley

 SOMA, Financial District & Downtown

 Twin Peaks, West Portal & Glen Park

Schedule Your San Francisco Roof Inspection Today

Don't let minor roof leaks or coastal wear turn into expensive interior damage. Partner with local San Francisco professionals who know how to protect your investment.
